scheme_name: MeitY - Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme For Electronics & IT
other_conditions: Minimum Grade Point Average of 6.5/10 (60%) in relevant M.E./M.Tech/M.S. programmes (55% marks for SC/ST candidates)
Minimum Grade Point Average of 6.5/10 (60%) in relevant Bachelor’s programmes with a valid GATE score
Minimum CGPA of 8.0 in a relevant Bachelor’s degree from an Indian Institute of Technology (IIT)
First Class (6.5 GPA) or 60% marks (55% for SC/ST) in relevant Masters or equivalent science/engineering degrees with a valid GATE/UGC/CSIR‑NET qualification
Institutions must comply with UGC’s minimum standards and procedures for M.Phil./Ph.D. awards (Regulation 2009)
Eligible institutions include IITs, NITs, IISc, IISERs, Central Universities, Deemed Universities, State Universities, Private Universities, and other recognized academic/research institutions
Institutions must have existing postgraduate streams in ESDM/IT/ITES and have produced PhDs in these areas for the last three years
Institutions should be recognized by AICTE and NBA accredited for ESDM/IT programmes, or accredited by NAAC
benefits_summary: Provides fellowship up to ₹43,750 per month for full‑time PhDs, a one‑time incentive of ₹2.5  lakh for part‑time PhDs, and a monthly fellowship of ₹20,000 plus an annual research grant of ₹5  lakh for young faculty fellows.
documents_required: Printed application form from institute website
Reference letter with subject line “Reference letter for [Your Name]”
